ESTABLISHED ENGINEERING EXCELLENCE

State-of-the-Art 3D CAD, FEA Simulation & CFD Optimization

At Bellator Engineers, we understand the importance of delivering tailored solutions to meet specific application requirements. Our products are meticulously designed through in-depth application studies and utilizing cutting-edge 3D CAD technology.

To ensure optimal performance, we employ Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) during the product design process. This attention to detail allows us to meet and exceed application requirements and enables our Damper Valve Designs to comply with SIL and CE requirements.

Motorized Dampers

Electric multi-turn actuators with modulating 4–20mA control & fieldbus protocol.

Pneumatic Dampers

Hydraulic Dampers

Manual Damper Valves

PROACTIVE RELIABILITY • FAILURE PREVENTION

Design Failure Modes & Effect Analysis (DFMEA)

A structured engineering discipline to anticipate, identify, and mitigate potential failure modes before commissioning.

At Bellator Engineers, we prioritize proactive measures to prevent failures and ensure reliability. We conduct Design Failure Modes and Effect Analysis (DFMEA) for every product design, following international standards.

This structured approach enables us to identify and address potential problems or failures and their resulting effects on the system or process before any adverse events occur in the field.

01

Potential Failure Mode Identification

Evaluating blade bending moments under peak differential pressure, shaft seizure under extreme temperature conditions, and abrasive particulate entrapment in sealing lands.

02

Root Cause & Severity Classification

Determining Risk Priority Numbers (RPN) for thermal stress differentials, gland leakage, actuator stall torque, and aggressive flue-gas acid condensation.

03

Proactive Design Countermeasures

Incorporating external self-aligning bearings, lantern ring purge seals, refractory anchors, and mechanical stops before cutting metal.

Dedicated Research & Development Facility for Damper Valves

Bellator Engineers has a Separate Research & Development facility for Damper Valves with a dedicated team of R&D Engineers having experience of 14+ Years in Damper Valves Designing.

Separate R&D Division

Dedicated Damper Valve Design Center

Bhosari MIDC, Pune • Advanced Simulation Lab & Prototyping Workshop

All the designs are established in a 3D CAD tool using state-of-the-art design and analysis software. Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) are broadly used to enrich product designs.

01

15+ Years Dedicated R&D Team

Over 15 years of specialised experience in designing advanced damper valves, severe-duty aerodynamics, metallurgical selection, and extreme-temperature structural behavior.

02

CFD Flow & Low Pressure Drop Optimization

Utilizing Computational Fluid Dynamics to model gas turbulence, duct vortices, and velocity profiles, reducing parasitic fan power consumption for our clients.

03

Continuous DFMEA Execution

DFMEA is executed for every design of Butterfly Damper valves, divertor dampers, and guillotine gates to systematically eliminate potential site failures before fabrication starts.

GLOBAL PROCESS APPLICATIONS

Automated Damper Valves for 9 Critical Industries

Our wide range of Automated Damper Valves caters to Oil & Gas, Marine, Steel Plants, Thermal Power Plants, Nuclear Plants, Water, Cement, Paper & Pulp, and Sugar Industries worldwide.

01 • Hydrocarbon

Oil & Gas Industries

Refinery FCCU flue gas dampers, flare gas isolation, sulfur recovery units, and severe corrosive offshore applications.

02 • Maritime

Marine & Naval

Exhaust Gas Cleaning System (EGCS) scrubber wash dampers, bypass flap valves, and high-saline marine ventilation closing.

03 • Metallurgy

Steel Plants

Blast furnace hot blast valves, sinter plant dedusting isolation, reheat furnace air control, and coke oven battery dampers.

04 • Power Gen

Thermal Power Plants

Flue Gas Desulfurization (FGD) guillotine gates, air-seal zero-leakage diverters, ESP isolation, and boiler stack dampers.

05 • Nuclear

Nuclear Plants

Critical reactor containment ventilation closing devices, radiation-hardened seals, fast-acting trip dampers, and seismic qualification.

06 • Utilities

Water & Wastewater

Ventilation channel closing devices, aeration blower balancing butterfly dampers, odor control biofilter dampers.

07 • Minerals

Cement Plants

Raw mill tertiary air dampers, clinker cooler multi-louver dampers, high-dust baghouse isolation gates rated to 900°C.

08 • Process

Paper & Pulp

Chemical recovery boiler flue isolation, lime kiln exhaust dampers, chlorine dioxide corrosive vapor sealing gates.

09 • Agro-Biofuel

Sugar & Ethanol

Bagasse-fired boiler flue gas dampers, evaporator vapor bypass valves, distillery spent wash incinerator dampers.
